record.paper_title: Control theory of stochastic distributed parameter systems: recent progress and open problems
record.original_question: For stochastic parabolic equations, and more generally for stochastic distributed parameter systems, can one derive quantitative estimates for the control cost of approximate controllability, analogous to the known deterministic results for heat equations?

evidence.quote: (4) The cost for the approximate controllability for SDPSs. It is shown in [45] that stochastic parabolic equations are approximately controllable. But it does not give any estimate for the cost of the control. Can one generalize the results in [10] to stochastic parabolic equations? Furthermore, it deserves to study the cost of the approximate controllability for general SDPSs.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the stochastic parabolic equation on a bounded smooth domain $G \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ with control acting on a nonempty open subset $G_0 \subset G$:
$$
\begin{cases}
dy - \Delta y\,dt = \chi_{G_0} u\,dt + (a y + f) \,dW(t) & \text{in } (0,T) \times G,\\
y = 0 & \text{on } (0,T) \times \partial G,\\
y(0) = y_0 & \text{in } G,
\end{cases}
$$
where $W$ is a standard one-dimensional Brownian motion on a filtered probability space, $a \in L^\infty_{\mathbb F}(0,T;L^\infty(G))$, $y_0 \in L^2(G)$, $u$ is an $\mathbb F$-adapted control in $L^2_{\mathbb F}(0,T;L^2(G_0))$, and $f$ is an admissible $\mathbb F$-adapted source in $L^2_{\mathbb F}(0,T;L^2(G))$.

It is known that this system is approximately controllable: for any target $y_1 \in L^2(\Omega,\mathcal F_T;L^2(G))$ and any $\varepsilon > 0$, there exists an admissible control $u$ such that $\mathbb E\,\|y(T) - y_1\|^2_{L^2(G)} \le \varepsilon^2$.

Define the cost of approximate controllability as
$$
K(T,\varepsilon,y_0,y_1) = \inf\bigl\{\|u\|_{L^2_{\mathbb F}(0,T;L^2(G_0))} : \mathbb E\,\|y(T)-y_1\|^2_{L^2(G)} \le \varepsilon^2\bigr\}.
$$

Problem. Establish quantitative upper bounds for $K(T,\varepsilon,y_0,y_1)$ in terms of $T$, $\varepsilon$, $\|y_0\|_{L^2(G)}$, $\|y_1\|_{L^2(\Omega;L^2(G))}$ and the coefficient $a$, in analogy with the known explicit estimates available for the deterministic linear heat equation. More generally, derive analogous quantitative estimates for the cost of approximate controllability of general stochastic distributed parameter systems (including stochastic hyperbolic, Schrödinger, and higher-order equations).
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work on stochastic parabolic equations focuses primarily on null controllability and observability via Carleman estimates; quantitative cost estimates for approximate controllability analogous to the deterministic Fernández-Cara–Zuazua results have not been established in full generality. Some progress on related quantities (e.g., cost of null controllability in vanishing viscosity limits, approximate null-controllability with uniform cost for hypoelliptic Ornstein–Uhlenbeck) exists, but the general problem for stochastic parabolic systems and broader SDPSs appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: The Cost of Null Controllability for a Backward Stochastic Degenerate Parabolic Equation in the Vanishing Viscosity Limit
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates cost of null controllability with boundary control in the vanishing viscosity limit using Carleman estimates.
status_evidence.claim: Recent stochastic-parabolic controllability cost results address null (not approximate) controllability and special regimes.

status_evidence.title: Approximate Null-Controllability with Uniform Cost for the Hypoelliptic Ornstein–Uhlenbeck Equations
status_evidence.snippet: Approximate null-controllability with uniform cost for hypoelliptic Ornstein–Uhlenbeck equations.
status_evidence.claim: Related cost-of-approximate-controllability results exist only in specific deterministic/hypoelliptic settings.

status_evidence.title: Carleman Estimates and Controllability of Forward Stochastic Parabolic Equations with General Dynamic Boundary Conditions
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes null and approximate controllability with explicit estimates for null-controllability cost.
status_evidence.claim: Recent stochastic-parabolic work gives null-controllability cost estimates but not the analogous approximate-controllability cost in full generality.
